visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a young man with black hair, wearing a white sweater with a colorful geometric pattern. He is looking down at a small rectangular video overlay positioned in the lower center of the screen. This overlay shows another couple standing against a wall, where the male in the small video is demonstrating a hand-locking technique to a female. The background behind the main character is a plain white wall with vertical architectural slats. (2) The scene cuts to a full-body view of the same man standing in a narrow white hallway with several closed doors. He faces the camera, smiles, and waves his hand invitingly towards someone off-screen to his right. He is dressed in the same patterned sweater and dark trousers. The lighting is bright and even across the hallway environment. (3) A young woman with long black hair and glasses, wearing a loose grey oversized sweater, enters the frame from the right. They stand facing each other. The man reaches out to guide her hands, placing them together as seen in the instructional video from the first phase. He then lifts her joined hands and pins them against the white wall above her head. (4) The man leans in very close to the woman's face, creating a romantic atmosphere, but suddenly he raises his knee sharply towards her. The woman reacts immediately by hitting him and pushing him away. The man hunches over, clutching his midsection and leaning against the wall in apparent pain. He then looks directly into the camera with a grimacing expression as the woman exits the frame, still complaining and gesturing.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy pop-rock music with aggressive drums and electric guitar starts immediately, featuring a male singer spelling out the letters 'S-I-D-E-E-F-F-E-C-T-S' with high vocal arousal. The tempo is fast and the beat is driving. (2) A transition occurs as the music volume is ducked. A male voice speaks in Mandarin with a friendly, inviting tone: '幹嘛... 來啦', followed by a curious female response. There are subtle sounds of fabric rustling as the two interact. (3) The dialogue continues at a conversational pace as they coordinate their movements. A female voice says '手這樣' with a moderate pitch. The background music remains present but at a lower volume level. (4) The music swells back to full volume. A sharp, percussive impact sound effect coincides with a visual movement. Immediately, the female voice becomes high-arousal and agitated, shouting '神經病喔, 變態耶' with sharp intonation. (5) The male voice emits several low-pitched, strained groans of pain that overlap with the continuing high-energy music. The female voice trails off with a complaining exclamation '我的天啊, 非禮啊' before the audio cuts out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedy sketch designed to subvert viewer expectations of a romantic 'trend' or 'hack'. It uses a popular instructional video style as a setup for a slapstick payoff where the romantic gesture is replaced by a comedic physical failure and a subsequent angry/painful reaction.
